_note: Wave 5b (V4): the AAV support, the LHD, the company's motor pool, enemy vehicle QRFs and the AI gunner on a mounted gun. Everything here is Proposed (Captain decided: AAVs from the LHD on the coast or the FOB inland, commandable, transport; lost with their cargo and passengers; AAVs can't work mountains; the LHD is never attacked). Distances in metres, speeds in km/h, times in seconds.

aav._note: hot_zones: the support works in hot zones (design doc). contract_coast: and in contract zones on the coast (Proposed data switch). one_at_a_time: one support AAV out at once. A lost AAV is gone for the rest of the op (Captain). mountain_relief_m: a zone with hills this high (or "terrain": "mountain") is mountains; max_slope_deg: the steepest ground an AAV-7 climbs (60% grade). arrive_m: it stops this far short of whoever called it; follow_m / follow_gap_m: following, it closes in once further than follow_m and stops follow_gap_m short. dock_m: back within this of the LHD's stern or the FOB's road, it's gone.

lhd._note: The LHD (a Wasp/America-class amphibious assault ship, about 257 m by 32 m). lhd_m (zone "coast"): its centre line's distance from the coast's edge, default half the shoreline's, but never nearer the shore than Lhd.OFFSHORE_M (Captain, 2026-10-14: anchored offshore, never by the beach; past the zone's edge if the sea is narrow); lhd_along_m: along the coast from the middle. deck_m: the flight deck above the water; draft_m below it. fob_inset_m: inland, supports come in from the friendly FOB's side of the map this far inside its edge.

motor_pool._note: The company's vehicles between deployments (campaign section motor_pool). start: what a new campaign owns. value: what each model is worth (repairs cost repair_share of it for a vehicle written off, less for less damage, plus battery_price for a dead battery and fuel_price a litre to fill the tank); repair_days: days in the workshop for a vehicle written off (at least 1 for any damage). Zone weights say how much of the damage each hit zone's wear counts for. bring_offset_m: a vehicle brought on a deployment waits this far behind the insertion point; return_reach_m: it goes home if it's this close to the extraction point when the squad extracts.

vehicle_qrf._note: Hot zones: a QRF from a base rides in an enemy technical this share of the time (decided per launch from the zone's seed, the base and the count, so a replay is the same); the soldiers get out dismount_m short of where they're sent, or sooner if it's stuck stuck_s or hit; it's only worth it for min_drive_m and up. At most max_vehicles per wave; a wave too big for them walks the rest.

gunner._note: An AI gunner on a vehicle's mounted gun: looks for enemies every check_s out to range_m, fires bursts of burst rounds with pause_s between, spread_deg of aim error on top of the gun's own, and holds fire when a friend is within friend_clear_m of the line.
